Game Overview

At its heart, Cute Craft Lab is a dress up game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Cute Craft Lab comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Cute Craft Lab?

Cute Craft Lab is a free dress up game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Cute Craft Lab free to play?

Yes, Cute Craft Lab is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
